; unremarkable - a bedtime story from the diary entry you circle on the page.
; Adds a button to the handwriting selection menu, runs reMarkable's own
; recognizer over the selection, and feeds the text to the local model.
; Requires: qt-resource-rebuilder, qt-command-executor.

AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#selectionRoot
        LOCATE BEFORE cut
        INSERT {
            signal askStory
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE ?#tools
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#convertToText
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                id: askStoryButton
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                type: tools.type
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/open_book"
                onClicked: selectionRoot.askStory()
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#selectionHandler
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            onAskStory: {
                console.log("[unremarkable] askStory requested");
                root.convertSelection(function () {
                    hwcSelectionTool.askStoryFrom(
                        controller.cloneSelectedItems(controller.currentLayer,
                                                      root.defaultScale));
                    root.endItemSelection();
                });
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/HwcSelection.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick.Controls 2.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE BEFORE convert
        INSERT {
            property bool askingStory: false
            property string storyEntry: ""
            property string storyText: ""
            property string storyStatus: "idle"
            property var storyMeta: null

            CommandExecutor { id: storyRunner }

            function askStoryFrom(items) {
                askingStory = true;
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(items,
                    Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
            }

            function storyTopLevel() {
                var node = root;
                while (node.parent) { node = node.parent; }
                return node;
            }

            function stripQuotes(text) {
                var marks = String.fromCharCode(34, 39, 8220, 8221, 8216, 8217);
                while (text.length > 0 && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(0)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(1);
                }
                while (text.length > 0
                       && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(text.length - 1)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(0, text.length - 1);
                }
                return text.trim();
            }

            function wordCount(text) {
                if (!text) return 0;
                var parts = text.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(" ").split(" ");
                var total = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                    if (parts[i].length > 0) total++;
                }
                return total;
            }

            function storyRead(path, cb) {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) cb(xhr.responseText);
                };
                xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path);
                xhr.send();
            }

            function storyPoll() {
                storyRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/out.txt",
                          function(t) { root.storyText = t; });
                storyRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/status",
                          function(s) {
                              root.storyStatus = s;
                              if (s === "done") storyTimer.stop();
                          });
                storyRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/meta.json",
                          function(m) {
                              try { root.storyMeta = JSON.parse(m); }
                              catch (e) { root.storyMeta = null; }
                          });
            }

            function askStoryAbout(entry) {
                root.storyEntry = entry;
                root.storyText = "";
                root.storyMeta = null;
                root.storyStatus = "running";
                storyRunner.executeCommand("/home/root/unremarkable/ask-bg.sh",
                                           [entry, "240"]);
                storyPopup.parent = storyTopLevel();
                storyPopup.open();
                storyTimer.start();
            }

            // Recognition runs in reMarkable's cloud; offline it returns nothing.
            function storyFailed() {
                root.storyEntry = "";
                root.storyText = "";
                root.storyMeta = null;
                root.storyStatus = "failed";
                storyPopup.parent = storyTopLevel();
                storyPopup.open();
            }

            Timer {
                id: storyTimer
                interval: 2000
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: root.storyPoll()
            }

            Popup {
                id: storyPopup
                modal: true
                focus: true
                width: 1000
                height: 1180
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                padding: 0
                closePolicy: Popup.CloseOnEscape | Popup.CloseOnPressOutside

                background: Rectangle {
                    color: "#ffffff"
                    border.color: "#000000"
                    border.width: 3
                }

                contentItem: Item {
                    Column {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 0

                        Text {
                            text: root.storyStatus === "failed"
                                  ? "Couldn’t read the page"
                                  : root.storyStatus === "running"
                                  ? "Writing a bedtime story…"
                                  : "A bedtime story"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 52
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            visible: root.storyEntry !== ""
                            text: "from “" + root.storyEntry + "”"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.italic: true
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "#000000"
                            width: 872
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            topPadding: 6
                        }

                        Item { width: 1; height: 26 }
                        Rectangle { width: 872; height: 2; color: "#000000" }
                        Item { width: 1; height: 44 }

                        Text {
                            width: 872
                            text: root.storyStatus === "failed"
                                  ? "Handwriting recognition runs on reMarkable’s servers, "
                                    + "so the tablet needs Wi-Fi. Connect and try again."
                                  : root.storyText === ""
                                  ? "· · ·"
                                  : root.stripQuotes(root.storyText)
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 34
                            color: "#000000"
                            lineHeight: 1.35
                            lineHeightMode: Text.ProportionalHeight
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            maximumLineCount: 16
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                        }
                    }

                    Column {
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 18

                        Rectangle { width: 872; height: 1; color: "#000000" }

                        Text {
                            text: "SmolLM2-135M bedtime fine-tune · q8_0 · 2 threads · armv7l"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: root.storyMeta
                                  ? "ttft " + (root.storyMeta.ttft_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)
                                    + "s  ·  " + root.storyMeta.decode_tok_s.toFixed(2)
                                    + " tok/s  ·  " + root.storyMeta.generated_tokens
                                    + " tok  ·  " + Math.round(root.storyMeta.peak_rss_mib)
                                    + " MiB rss"
                                  : root.storyStatus === "failed" ? ""
                                  : "generating · " + root.wordCount(root.storyText)
                                    + " words"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                    }
                }

                onClosed: storyTimer.stop()
            }

        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#handwritingBar
        REBUILD onFinishedChanged
        LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
        INSERT {
if (askingStory) {
    if (!finished) {
        return;
    }
    var entry = recognitionJob.plainText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(" ").trim();
    console.log("[unremarkable] recognized entry: [" + entry + "]");
    askingStory = false;
    if (entry !== "") {
        root.askStoryAbout(entry);
    } else {
        root.storyFailed();
    }
    return;
}
}
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
